query.text: 请帮我留意做菜的操作，有倒偏等明显不当操作时提醒我纠正。
query.text_en: Please watch my cooking, and correct me if there is an obvious mistake such as pouring off to the side.

annotation.text_zh: 牛奶倒偏了，没有倒进杯子里。
annotation.text_en: The milk was poured off to the side and missed the cup.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
